fieldValues.title: Orientation cost crowds out the work
fieldValues.statement: An agent starting cold spends a large share of its budget just learning what constrains its change: a fixed tool-list cost, then heavy reads of well-connected records. When orientation costs this much, the agent skips it or works from a partial picture. The deeper gap may be that context is not shaped for a newcomer.
source_ref: srs-context:context read inlines whole neighbour records: ~6.5k (CLI) / ~9k (MCP) tokens
